column1: # The fewest graded values each spec must still be checking.
# A test that carries its own answers can pass by doing NOTHING -- `grade-reals`
# on two empty lists reports `ok 0`, and a spec whose input list an edit emptied
# would sail through a gate that only greps for BAD. This is the floor that
# catches that: run.sh sums the `ok N` counts and refuses if a spec has dropped
# A FLOOR AND NOT A GOLD, deliberately. It is `>=`, so adding assertions never
# churns this file and nobody is tempted to "update the expected number" as a
# reflex when something goes red. Raise a line when a spec grows enough that the
# old floor stopped meaning anything; that is a deliberate act and should look
# Seeded 2026-09-04 at each spec's then-current count.
